programs.description: A nature lover pushes her ambitious human resettlement proposal to a world that is not ready for it. However, a data-related catastrophe may change everything.
A woman with terminal lung cancer helps her seven-year-old son develop the emotional strength to live his life without her.
Inspector Maya Verma arrests defiant Kanchan from the red light area. Their conversation unveils an unexpected revelation.
A girl whose childhood is marred by violent household disputes grows up feeling helpless and anxious, developing hostility towards authority and triggering colossal consequences.
Lifelong friends turned spouses navigate moments of doubt reassurance and reflection that reveal the depth of their connection and what true partnership requires.

Vikrant returns home after 15 years, confronting unresolved tensions with his mother. He faces painful truths and rekindles old wounds, searching for answers to heal their fractured relationship. However, Vikrant must reconcile with his past to build a brighter future.
Young Danish strives to become a professional kabaddi player with his father's unwavering support. Just as a major opportunity arises, his world shatters when his father passes away.
Family drama, an empty wallet and chaotic twists stand in the way of a desperate gym freak and his ultimate cheat day meal.
A maid is shocked to find the owner of the house where she works dead. Upon telling her partner, he plans a scheme to rob the house.

Saurabh finds a match on a dating app and recruits his friend Shobhit for help. But when Shobhit steals the spotlight and the girl, chaos ensues! Friendships are tested as lies unravel, until a surprise match changes everything in this fun tale of love and loyalty.
The host sheds light on some of the latest news, developments and current affairs pertaining to various issues of public and national interest.
Shruti, a spoiled rich girl, dislikes her father's strict behaviour towards her. Later, she and her boyfriend, Aakash, devise a plan to kidnap her to help her escape his strict parenting.
Karthik and Meghna flaunt their hickeys, making their sexual chemistry obvious to everyone.
When Javed brings home a second wife, Afsana, his first wife Rukhsar is devastated. However, an unexpected bond begins to form when the true nature of their husband comes to light.
A bashful tech professional's day is made every morning when he meets a self-assured woman in the office elevator. However, being tongue-tied around her on a daily basis soon begins to torment him.
Newlyweds Raj and Neha experience strange occurrences in their new abode. Subsequently, they uncover the home's connection to their former lives and an endless loop of romance.

A mother calls out to her daughter, only to be scolded by her husband. Her daughter, Meera, is a special child who cannot speak or hear, yet her mother sends her to school with hope. Despite the chaos and negativity around her, Meera remains unaware, finding beauty and positivity in everything.
When an actor levies a director with allegations of harassment and sexual misconduct, his career is at stake. But is there truth to her claims?
Nikita and Neeraj share a long-standing acquaintance, yet she feels uncomfortable with Neeraj's physical contact. Adding to her dilemma, Aniket has recently proposed to her.

A couple navigates the ups and downs of their relationship, with him being shorter and her towering over him. From playful teasing by the maid to awkward encounters, his height becomes a source of humor and occasional frustration. However, amidst the laughs and challenges, her unwavering love reassures him that their bond transcends any physical differences. Join them on a delightful journey of love and laughter, where acceptance triumphs over insecurities.
A cab driver's quiet routine is shattered when she picks up an apparently innocuous passenger carrying a red suitcase. What starts off as a simple ride soon turns into a twisted journey.
A mother loves her child dearly, which gives the latter the strength and courage to overcome various obstacles and face fears.
When his daughter is killed by the terrorist he is chasing, Daanish, a policeman, vows revenge. He finds a confidante in Pandit, a grandmaster, who is also mourning the loss of his daughter.
Two brothers, who are aspiring filmmakers, are forced to use their mother's fund to make their film. However, disagreements arise when their mother does not approve the contents of the film.
Kartik and Ishita reconnect for a final chat, stirring up old emotions and unresolved issues. However, Uljhan delves into the complexities of closure.
In a small town near Delhi, two young boys from contrasting socioeconomic backgrounds happen to have a fateful encounter.

Chitra, a method actor known for her ability to deliver realistic performances, starts preparing for her next role. However, things take a dark turn when the intensity of her character and her desire to excel in her work cause her to lose touch with reality.
Rahul and Priya meet during a trip to Goa and fall in love with each other. However, their lives take a turn when Rahul learns that Priya is the sibling of Shiva, who had once tortured his sister.
A successful businessman decides to take a break from his mundane life and goes on a vacation. Furthermore, he happens to meet a stranger who transforms him.

The Struggle of an Actress in the Film Industry: A young woman faces difficulties when working with a demanding director who creates a stressful environment. She expresses her concerns to the producer, but he reacts angrily and uses harsh language toward her. Will the actress decide to find a way to work together or stand up for herself?

This is the story of a couple who tried to raise their voice against the undesirable practice of one community. Hamraz is a witness to the hero playing Ravanahatha and the incidents that happened to him... Sometimes the image that looks white is also black... Hamraz is a story full of mysteries... The curtain will soon fall on all the secrets and the real story will come out in front of everyone.
A wealthy amnesiac returns home, discovers his family's murderous plot, later dies from poisoned food, however promises ghostly vengeance.
A wealthy amnesiac returns home, discovers his family's murderous plot, later dies from poisoned food, however promises ghostly vengeance.
A man with a scientific background deals with a mysterious health condition. However, destiny intervenes and cures his issue.
A father's rigid preference for a male heir over his loving daughter exposes deeply rooted societal biases and traditional expectations.

Amidst Mumbai's chaos, the COVID crisis upends Ayush and Roohi's lives as Ayush faces unemployment. Consequently, Roohi launches a meal delivery venture to sustain their household. Nevertheless, Ayush's conventional mindset and bruised pride spark discord as he grapples with his spouse becoming the family's primary provider.
A newly wedded woman faces colourism from her mother-in-law. While her husband wants to fight this prejudice, she decides to navigate it and maintain her dignity within the family.

Two siblings dwelling in a distant land who yearn to transmit a sugary delicacy to their ailing patriarch. These brothers diligently arrange the dispatch of a confection to comfort their father during his recovery.
An honest police officer dedicated to uprooting crime ruffles the feathers of corrupt politicians and criminals, who scheme to stop him.
A troubled housewife, weary and worn down by her husband's numerous past misdeeds, finally seeks the retribution she believes is long overdue.
Sara's twin sister disappears in a bizarre manner, leaving her to deal with the loss. However, when she is unable to come to terms with it, Sara decides to find answers.
A devout Hindu's quest for vengeance is complicated by his two friends with conflicting ideologies, both of whom attempt to manipulate his actions.

programs.showName: A Tale Of An Onion Witch Chapter 2
programs.description: A newlywed couple encounters a woman claiming to be Mangla, who cautions them about an ancient witch roaming the area at night in search of onions. However, the situation takes an unexpected turn when a young girl desperately seeks assistance by knocking on their door at the stroke of midnight, plunging the couple into a potentially perilous scenario.

Two college time friends embark on a long drive on a Sunday morning, leaving their bustling city lives behind. As they amble through the hilly roads, they reveal to each other, their old longings and hidden pasts. Their rose-tinted nostalgia is broken, and they come face to face with their imperfect lives.

Haunted by the riots that took his parents 20 years ago, Karan confronts the man who once loved him as a son-yet betrayed him in the worst way. Torn between revenge and forgiveness, he seeks meaning in the madness. A powerful story of loss, betrayal, and the fight for redemption.
In a bleak realm where joy is absent, the Be Khush tablet offers instant bliss for any event. However, chaos may ensue when a person distributes it gratis.
A determined village girl struggles to attend school as her family expects her to stay home, but her love for learning drives her to find clever ways to keep studying.
After being rejected by their fathers, Raju and Anu elope and get settled in a village but when the parents learn about their whereabouts, they decide to bring them back.
A man grapples with a speech disorder that affects his daily life. Despite this, he decides to face his greatest fear and attempts to date a woman.
Karthik's parents' divorce sparks worry in Anvith about his own family. Trying to keep the peace at home, Anvith's efforts backfire, leading to a proper barney between his mother and father.

Bahar Aa Chaman Prakash delves into the story of a man reluctant to marry his lifelong acquaintance. Shutting himself away and avoiding his father, he faces the girl his father wishes him to wed. When she joins him and locks themselves in a room, they emerge with a revelation connected to the man's inner struggles. Will his father embrace this truth?
A heartbroken man sits alone in a bar, haunted by the end of a relationship, and confronts the agonising necessity of saying a final goodbye.
Whilst managing her fledgling venture, Shruthi confronts feelings of solitude as she traverses the complexities of daily existence, striving to find her place in a bustling world.

programs.showName: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
programs.description: Two flatmates hear about a witch who wanders around and asks for onions. However, they become shocked when the witch turns out to be an attractive woman instead.
A desperate writer plans one final movie pitch to a producer. However, he ends up driving the producer in his taxi, giving him an unexpected opportunity to share his idea during the ride.
Finance Minister and her secretary seize black money, yet half goes missing. Later, the secretary reveals he's behind the theft as part of a secret plan. The story ends unresolved.

A film about a girl moving to Kolkata for her new job. She chooses a hotel for overnight stay where an incident makes her realize that life revolves in a circle and carries her emotionally very close to her home and family.
A family struggles to manage their daily expenses following the death of the patriarch. Desperate, the youngest son steals a chicken despite the family's vegetarian beliefs.

23B Raheja is a gripping one-night drama that peels back the glossy layers of the entertainment industry to expose the shadows lurking beneath. The story revolves around a celebrated casting director whose charm masks a long trail of manipulation and exploitation. His power begins to crumble when a young woman arrives at his door, posing as an aspiring actress but with a haunting connection to his past. As the night unfolds, so does a tense game of revelations.

A young woman gets married, with the typical expectations of a blissful domestic life. However, her dreams turn into a nightmare when her mother-in-law constantly harasses and humiliates her solely because she has been unable to conceive after five years of marriage.
A withdrawn young man living with his father begins to regain purpose when a wedding next door brings people noise and quiet moments of unexpected hope.
After a heated breakup, an angry girl calls her older sister for a late-night pickup. However, they soon get into a fight and are pulled over by the police.
A lonely city-dweller named Aryan becomes unsettled when he sees a young woman acting strangely. When he decides to confront her, the encounter leads to a major turning point for them both.
Burdened by debt, a struggling village couple faces a bitter misunderstanding when the husband wrongly suspects his wife of being involved with a corrupt moneylender.
A fake astrologer doubts the link between stars and fate but tricks people daily. However, his daughter's illness leads him to question his beliefs and confront his past.
A demented delivery man forces himself inside the house of a young lady, threatening to kill her. However, the confrontation takes an unusual turn when the true nature of his visit is revealed.
While Rohit lovingly takes care of his dog, Bruno, Mr Mehra's children mistreat him. However, matters change when Mr Mehra meets Bruno.
Just one day before their wedding, Ritesh confesses something to Yami that threatens to change the course of their relationship.

An ageing mother, living with her entitled son and his wife, finds her sight blurring and clearing like a malfunctioning camera lens one morning. Soon, a visit to a nearby eye clinic, strongly suggested by her young neighbour, leads to unexpected revelations.
An unexpected tale of a rainy morning brings about a question about the existence of hidden evil behaviour in relationships.
On the surface, Indian immigrant Kritika and her Pakistani husband Faiz appear to be happily married. Underneath, however, their inter-faith union is caught in between love and cultural differences.

The journey of a woman named Mira, who, like many others, finds herself questioning the foundation of her relationship. As she navigates the ups and downs of her own love story, she reflects on the nature of love and the challenges of maintaining a lasting connection.
A routine gym outing for three friends becomes a series of unusual interactions with diverse strangers. Their day reaches a pivotal moment when they cross paths with an enigmatic street dweller.
A girl holds her brother hostage but first, she must confront the dark side of her life and face the harsh truths that threaten to break her.
A misunderstanding about his lover and friend propels Manav into a violent rage.

A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stranger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the stranger's wife.
A wife struggles to differentiate between her dreams and reality, which affects her daily life. Consequently, their once-strong marriage faces unexpected challenges.
A woman faces sexual harassment at the hands of her boss. Later, she decides to teach him a lesson with the help of her colleague.
A young student struggles with academic pressure due to poor performance. However, she sets out on a path of self-discovery and soon finds her true passion.
Widower Mukesh lives with son Rahul, 28. Rahul finds his father's behavior odd and Mukesh resents his son's constant judgment of his choices.

A young professional grapples with career setbacks and monetary woes, sinking into despondency. Meanwhile, his inner dialogue veers towards destructive habits, with his negative self urging escapism through substance abuse or self-harm. However, despite finding temporary solace in this gloomy mindset, he yearns for his long-neglected positive self, sensing an underlying dissatisfaction with his current state.
Bena is dismissed from her job following an alleged jewellery theft. The misunderstanding quickly escalates into a personal struggle as Bena faces deep-seated prejudice due to her name.
Two young lovers prepare for their first kiss, but their glasses get in the way, leading to awkward moments and unexpected challenges as they navigate their budding romance.

When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes collide there would be chaos, confusion and a lot of disagreement. But would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Find out Kamrul's unique take on life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.
A cab driver's kind attempt to help a weeping woman who dashed out of her house after a fight with her husband goes terribly wrong.
Frances and Robert Dufresne, a middle-aged couple living in New York City, decide to separate. Subsequently, their dislike for each other often results in hilarious situations.
Arun begins hating Kavita when he is forced to drop out of college after a misunderstanding with her. But when he loses his vision in an accident, Kavita poses as his fiancée and takes care of him.
After some time apart, Meera and Ranbir find their relationship at a point where it becomes a perfect example of the shallowness and fragility of modern-day dating.

Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.
Feuding next-door neighbours dispatch their ill-mannered fourteen-year-old daughter Firni to stay occupied. Meanwhile, the residents manage the adolescent's challenging presence.
Ruby, raised to believe in her potential, however, finds herself married to a traditional man, Vivek. After motherhood, she decides to pursue an advertising career, sparking unforeseen troubles.
Individuals from different walks of life and social classes demonstrate the interdependence of each social stratum on the other through their duties and responsibilities.

Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father's regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he's caused?
A light bulb falls in love with a human.

Against the setting of a journey to Thailand, Ayush, a lustful businessman, possesses both the capability and cleverness to be unfaithful to his wife and shatter her aspirations of moving to Canada. Yet, the question remains: Can he thwart her pursuit of realizing her dreams?
Shiv lives alone, writing poetry on an old computer that breaks down. However, a service visit arranged by his son brings unexpected nostalgia, surprises and an intriguing exchange offer.
As a family decides to go for a drive, the father stays adamant on driving. His views on technology lead him to not trust navigational systems, but he himself struggles with directions.

Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves? Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.
A daughter brings her shy mother to a matchmaking office. Meanwhile, an awkward talk with a professional leads to deep introspection for all three individuals present at the meeting.

What would you do if you unexpectedly obtain magical powers? Ashwath, a failed businessman is having a troubled relationship with his wife. One fine morning he gets a Sand-timer at his doorstep. Life takes a turn when he discovers magical powers in it. Will the Sand-timer be a boon or curse?
Follow the emotional struggle between ambitious youth and weary elders facing the grip of old age as they endure the pain of losing independence and becoming reliant on others.
Damdi, a young child left by his parents, is brought up by his grandmother. Growing up, he becomes engulfed in addiction and faces several problems as a result, but finally finds a new path in life.
